title: make clean failed with an error on sonic-buildimage
author: dprital
body:

#### Description

running "make clean" under sonic-buildimage failed with an error:

rm: cannot remove 'target/versions/dockers/docker-platform-monitor': Is a directory
make: *** [slave.mk:1516: target/docker-platform-monitor.gz-clean] Error 1

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Build sonic-buildimage (by make target)
2. Clean with "make clean"
3. Operation failed and error is rasied

#### Describe the results you received:

rm: cannot remove 'target/versions/dockers/docker-platform-monitor': Is a directory
make: *** [slave.mk:1516: target/docker-platform-monitor.gz-clean] Error 1

#### Describe the results you expected:

make clean success
